title: Convert an ISO 8601 date-time with an offset to UTC
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: Its pattern allows any day from 01 to 31 and Date rolls the overflow forward, so "2026-02-29T00:00:00Z" returns "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z" instead of throwing RangeError.
It validates every field including days per month and leap years, applies the offset with a single correct day rollover, and refuses results outside years 0001 to 9999.
The brief asks for a JavaScript function toUtc, and the delivery is a Python function to_utc with no JavaScript code.
Building the date with UTC setters and reading it back refuses impossible days, and the offset and year bounds are applied as the brief specifies.
